P72.density_consequence: for every epsilon>0, a_i>(8/9-epsilon)*log2(i) on a density-one set of positive indices
hypotheses: S is a positive tail minimum of a nonperiodic Collatz orbit
the tail is coefficient-safe at every ordinary shortcut prefix
x_j=T^(d_j)(S) is the j-th odd iterate and d_0=0
packing_lemmas: the r-th ordered post-initial value z_r satisfies z_r>=S+3*(r-1) for r>=2

Lagarias_1985.overlap: critical parity density only; no a_j packing bound is imported
Lagarias_1985.result: a trajectory tending to infinity has lower parity-one density at least ln(2)/ln(3)

Lopez_Stoll_2009_2021.overlap: the all-contact word is the upper mechanical word of slope ln(2)/ln(3), but positivity is ruled out here by P72 rather than imported
Lopez_Stoll_2009_2021.result: critical-slope Sturmian parity words are studied; the 2021 preprint states equality of lower density for a divergent rational 2-adic orbit

Monks_Yazinski_2004.overlap: extends the known density domain; Phase 12 uses positive integer odd-value packing instead
Monks_Yazinski_2004.result: the same lower-density restriction holds for divergent rational 2-adic orbits

literature_overlap.novelty_boundary: No claim of literature-wide novelty is made; the inspected sources do not state the P72 odd-value packing inequality in this notation.

proof_certificate.density_step: with A=floor((8/9-epsilon)log2(j)), the exceptional count is O(j^(1-epsilon))
proof_certificate.packing_count: each complete interval of six integers contains exactly two residues coprime to six

what_this_result_does_not_prove: P72 constrains but does not exclude an infinite coefficient-safe tail, a nontrivial cycle, the renewal ladder, or a Collatz counterexample.
